title: Perform OptiSweep CloseOut Through the WCS API
summary: Use POST CloseOut in the OptiSweep / WCS API through Apidog or an equivalent approved API client for a bag-out operation. CloseOut closes all chutes and exchanges totes containing parcels.
when_to_use: Use the OptiSweep / WCS API when the customer wants to perform a bag-out operation using CloseOut.
not_for: Do not use CloseOut as a substitute for Purge. Purge exchanges every tote in the system and does not print a label, while CloseOut exchanges totes containing parcels.
Do not use this procedure when the required operation is to cancel closeout exchanges that are not in progress; the source identifies Cancel Closeout for that situation.

roles_and_responsibilities.responsibility: Use the OptiSweep / WCS API through Apidog or an equivalent approved API client to execute POST CloseOut and observe the resulting chute and tote behavior.

safety_notes: CloseOut is associated with bag-out activity and changes chute and tote state.
Confirm that CloseOut, rather than Purge or Cancel Closeout, matches the required operation before sending the request.
access_or_tools_needed: Access to the primary server where Apidog is installed

access_required: L2_support access to the OptiSweep / WCS API
Access to Apidog or an equivalent approved API client
system_preconditions: A bag-out operation requiring CloseOut has been identified.

steps.title: Locate POST CloseOut in the OptiSweep / WCS API
steps.purpose: Select the API operation that performs the documented bag-out behavior.
steps.instruction: On the primary server, open Apidog or an equivalent approved API client for the OptiSweep / WCS API. In the System API list, locate POST CloseOut. Verify that the selected operation is CloseOut rather than Purge or Cancel Closeout.
steps.expected_result: POST CloseOut is available in the System API list and is selected for the bag-out operation.
steps.healthy_condition: The API client displays POST CloseOut under the OptiSweep / WCS System APIs.
steps.failure_condition: POST CloseOut is unavailable, the API client cannot access the OptiSweep / WCS API, or the required operation is actually Purge or Cancel Closeout.

steps.title: Execute POST CloseOut in the OptiSweep / WCS API
steps.purpose: Start the CloseOut operation for the identified bag-out.
steps.instruction: In the OptiSweep / WCS API client, execute POST CloseOut. Use the request configuration available in the approved client; the supplied source does not define request parameters or a response confirmation field.
steps.expected_result: The POST CloseOut request is submitted to the OptiSweep / WCS API for the bag-out operation.
steps.healthy_condition: The API client shows that POST CloseOut was submitted without an API access or request failure being reported.
steps.failure_condition: The request cannot be submitted, the API client reports an error, or the operation selected is not POST CloseOut.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: CloseOut is listed as POST CloseOut and is used when the customer wants to bag out.

steps.title: Observe CloseOut results on the live OptiSweep / WCS system
steps.purpose: Verify that the CloseOut operation produces the documented chute and tote effects.
steps.instruction: After submitting POST CloseOut, observe the live chute and tote status associated with the OptiSweep / WCS operation. Verify that all chutes close and that totes containing parcels are exchanged.
steps.expected_result: All chutes close and totes containing parcels are exchanged.
steps.healthy_condition: The live system shows closed chutes and exchange activity for totes containing parcels.
steps.failure_condition: One or more chutes remain open, or a tote containing parcels is not exchanged as expected.

actions.exact_action: Observe the live chute status and verify that all chutes close.

actions.label: Check tote exchange
actions.exact_action: Observe the live tote status and verify that totes containing parcels are exchanged.

stop_or_escalate_if: Totes containing parcels are not exchanged as described.
CloseOut remains incomplete or its resulting live state cannot be verified.
